cases.name: bootstrap-auth
cases.oracle: Fresh setup once; unauthenticated calls denied; no shared password

cases.name: local-project
cases.oracle: Concurrent project creation yields one canonical conversation; optional integrations absent; OXRM readiness backed by provisioner evidence

cases.name: duplicate-ingress
cases.oracle: Ten concurrent identical requests return original IDs with one message/event/inbox; changed text returns 409

cases.name: receipt-restart
cases.oracle: After 202 receipt SIGKILL only owned server; reopen same home; exact acknowledged order and IDs survive

cases.name: busy-roles
cases.oracle: Pause deep 30 seconds; fast/deep distinct IDs and independent worker; ten concurrent inputs persist; receipt p95 <250ms on declared SSD hardware

cases.name: sse-replay
cases.oracle: Reconnect after sequence N; subsequent events ordered, no duplicate presentation; stale cursor explicit resync; slow consumer bounded

cases.name: stale-lease
cases.oracle: Replace lease generation; old worker completion and dispatch denied without ledger mutations

cases.name: owner-spoof
cases.oracle: Worker payload actor_kind=owner cannot authorize effect, remove hold or succeed task

cases.name: cross-project
cases.oracle: Unauthorized principal cannot read conversation/events/run or mutate hold/approval via foreign IDs

cases.name: stop-fence
cases.oracle: Hang provider; cancel persists fence before interrupt; post-fence dispatch denied; pre-fence action remains in-flight until reconciliation

cases.name: exact-approvals
cases.oracle: Mutated target/args/scope/version, expired and reused approval denied; simultaneous decisions consume once

cases.name: unknown-effect
cases.oracle: Kill before intent, after intent, after dispatch before receipt; restart quarantines unknown outcomes and never blindly redispatches

cases.name: completion-evidence
cases.oracle: Duplicate completion does not duplicate result; prose done without verifier evidence cannot succeed

cases.name: isolation
cases.oracle: Candidate homes/cookies/providers/processes disjoint; stopping owned candidate leaves 1.x untouched

cases.name: web-ios
cases.oracle: Real web build and editable composer; native simulator build/navigation/keyboard/reconnect evidence; screenshot insufficient

cases.name: import-idempotency
cases.oracle: Synthetic consistent snapshot apply twice has stable mappings/counts/hashes; conflicting source identity quarantined

cases.name: import-dormancy
cases.oracle: Orphans/cycles/missing artifacts reported; source hashes unchanged; imported runs/timers/routes/outbox dormant; credentials excluded; consent preserved
